title: UK High Court upholds Met Police live facial recognition policy
summary: The High Court dismissed the Thompson and Carlo (Big Brother Watch) judicial review, finding the Met's live facial recognition policy lawful; claimants plan to appeal.
reason: Court clears the way for wider police facial recognition; national precedent. Judgment dated 21 Apr per judiciary.uk summary (some coverage dated later).

title: Unauthorized users accessed Anthropic's restricted Claude Mythos Preview
summary: Bloomberg reported a Discord group gained access to the withheld cyber-capable Mythos Preview via a third-party contractor environment; Anthropic said its own systems were not affected.
reason: Containment failure for a model deliberately withheld for cyber-risk reasons.

title: Alibaba releases Qwen 3.6-Max-Preview, its most powerful model
summary: Alibaba previewed proprietary Qwen 3.6-Max aimed at coding and agentic tasks for enterprise customers.
reason: Incremental Chinese frontier model update; self-reported.
